review.editorial_summary: Claims all five commands and 87 entity types implemented; final build, regression and sanitizer checks are corroborated. Current grading is 247/249, exposing a shared zero-count Hollerith error in reader and writer. External CAD validation remains unverified.
review.notes:
Substantial general C++20 codecs and geometry implementation, with no canned-answer or hidden-test evidence in the retained independent content review. Preserved checks corroborate 117 type/form fixtures, 79 CLI/Global checks, 1200 deterministic damaged-input cases and final normal plus address/undefined-behavior sanitizer runs. External CAD samples were unavailable, as acknowledged. Official unchanged-source IGES1.0.19 regrading is 247/249; reader acceptance and writer emission of illegal 0H remain two observations of one shared misconception. All246 unchanged case outcomes match the prior259/261 publication, and all three consolidated appendix integrations pass. The independently reviewed fixture normalization and15-to-3 consolidation explicitly reduce the denominator261-to-249; this is revised scoring weight, not implementation improvement. Complete prior publication, original source/result, model inputs, session usage and cost are preserved. Root verified clean committed rubric, pinned9a4 grader, unique cases and matching session accounting. No generation calls were made.

Run conditions: apps explicitly disabled in the recorded launch; no external tool invocation observed.
